$schema-note: G9-04 REQ-003. The declared list of every external host the deployed bundle may reach. This file is the source of truth in the repository; the Discord developer portal is configured FROM it, never the other way round. web/deploy.check.mjs asserts both directions: no host in the bundle that is missing here, no entry here that nothing in the bundle reaches.

$entry-shape.prefix: the path prefix the Activity requests, e.g. "/wiki"
$entry-shape.target: the target host, a stable hostname and never a per-deployment URL (REQ-015)
$entry-shape.reason: why this host exists in the bundle at all
$entry-shape.question: the question id in docs/ACTIVITY-SPIKE.md whose answered row justifies it (REQ-001)

$why-empty: Zero entries is the deliberate end state for external hosts: REQ-006 deletes the in-page API resolver and REQ-008 self-hosts the two font requests, after which the bundle reaches nothing outside its own origin. The one entry that would still be needed — the root mapping to the deploy origin — is not written here because it cannot yet be written honestly: docs/ACTIVITY-SPIKE.md carries no deploy-url and no answered row, and REQ-001 calls a value with no question id behind it a guess. docs/DEPLOY.md records the same decision against the same evidence: no deploy host exists yet, so there is no origin for the entry to name.
